mapper.sql: CASE WHEN u.phonenumber IS NULL OR TRIM(u.phonenumber) = '' THEN NULL WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(u.phonenumber) >= 7 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(u.phonenumber, 3), '****', RIGHT(u.phonenumber, 4)) ELSE '***' END
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.nick_name AS nickname, AS phone_masked, COALESCE(uac.enabled, 0) AS enabled, uac.reason, op.nick_name AS operator_name, uac.operated_at AS updated_at FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN user_author_capability uac ON uac.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user op ON op.user_id = uac.operator_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.user_type IN ('01', '02', '03') AND u.del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1
SELECT uac.enabled FROM user_author_capability uac WHERE uac.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_author_capability (user_id, enabled, reason, operator_id, operated_at, create_by, create_time, update_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{enabled}, #{reason}, #{operatorId}, NOW(), #{updateBy}, NOW(), #{updateBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), reason = VALUES(reason), operator_id = VALUES(operator_id), operated_at = VALUES(operated_at), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = NOW()
